test_title: PYST 95: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 30 Mar, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

_______ is not an option for me. I have to succeed at any cost.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Failure**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**Failure**" means lack of success.
 
• In the given context, the sentence emphasizes that not succeeding is not an option.
 
• The other options: "**Failhood**," "**Failed**," and "**Loser**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Failure is not an option for me. I have to succeed at any cost.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Failhood**: not a standard English word.
 
• **Failed**: past tense of fail, does not fit the context.
 
• **Loser**: refers to a person who loses, does not fit the context.
